seg.seg_note: Five segments: Test & Measurement, Environmental, Life Sciences & Diagnostics, Dental, Industrial Technologies (+ Other = unallocated corporate). NOTE: no segment re-organisation in 2015 filings - the Life Sciences / Diagnostics split and the Environmental & Applied Solutions segment only appear from 2016 (Fortive separation, Jul-2016). Communications business (split off to NetScout 14-Jul-2015) is discontinued operations; Test & Measurement and prior-year comparatives recast. Segment sales/OP from 10-K Note 19; segment growth, depreciation and amortization from 10-K MD&A segment sections; total-company growth from the Q4 release (year column). Growth convention: release/10-Q tables are additive (core + acquisitions + currency = total); stored with the model's deduction-to-core sign convention (total + acq + fx = core), i.e. acq/fx signs flipped vs the table.
